metadata.database: A Deeper China | Suzhou point decision layer

SZU001.guest_value: Clarify whether the visitor wants composition, history, photography or quiet.
SZU001.choose_rule: Use before selecting a famous garden.
SZU001.stop_after: One garden question and physical mode are clear.

SZU002.guest_value: Offer one close reading of large-scale garden composition.
SZU002.choose_rule: Choose only if current entry and crowd conditions fit.

SZU003.guest_value: Offer a different garden scale and rock/maze question.
SZU003.choose_rule: Choose instead of, not in addition to, the main garden by default.

SZU004.guest_value: Make garden crowd and attention cost visible before adding another garden.
SZU004.choose_rule: Use as a stop/exit method, not an attraction.
SZU004.stop_after: The visitor leaves before crowding replaces observation.

SZU005.guest_value: Read canal, homes, commerce and public life as a working urban fabric.
SZU005.choose_rule: Use one continuous public route; private homes are not attractions.

SZU006.guest_value: Use museum architecture and collection as one Suzhou modernity question.
SZU006.choose_rule: Choose by opening/programme and do not add another museum automatically.
SZU006.stop_after: One relationship between old form and current institution is clear.

SZU007.guest_value: Offer Kunqu or silk craft as a current cultural form.
SZU007.choose_rule: Use only after programme, language, seating and consent are confirmed.

SZU008.guest_value: Separate silk/craft learning from buying and provenance claims.
SZU008.choose_rule: No quality, price or seller guarantee.
SZU008.stop_after: The visitor knows what can and cannot be verified.

SZU009.guest_value: Make the famous canal-street trade-off explicit.
SZU009.choose_rule: Use only if commercial energy fits; do not call it a quiet local route by default.
SZU009.stop_after: The visitor decides the commercial layer serves the brief.

SZU010.guest_value: Make a water-town a separate transfer and settlement question.
SZU010.choose_rule: Do not add to a same-day garden sprint.
SZU010.stop_after: The visitor accepts the extra day, crowd and weather cost.

SZU011.guest_value: Offer canal/industrial water-city history beyond picturesque lanes.
SZU011.choose_rule: Choose when infrastructure/urbanism is the question.

SZU012.guest_value: Offer a present-day Suzhou layer for repeat visitors.
SZU012.choose_rule: Choose only when current programme/public access answers a real question.

SZU013.guest_value: Make Shanghai–Suzhou timing and one-anchor discipline explicit.
SZU013.choose_rule: Use one garden or one city-history question only.
SZU013.stop_after: The visitor has a rail/last-mile buffer and a return plan.

SZU014.guest_value: Show when an overnight materially improves garden/water-city pacing.
SZU014.choose_rule: Recommend overnight when a day trip cannot carry the intended question.
SZU014.stop_after: The visitor accepts hotel and transfer cost.

SZU015.guest_value: Compare Shanghai, Suzhou and Hangzhou by distinct questions.
SZU015.choose_rule: Require minimum nights and do not add all three by default.
SZU015.stop_after: The sequence and transfer cost are accepted.

SZU016.guest_value: Protect station arrival, luggage and local movement from consuming the day.
SZU016.choose_rule: Build from station, hotel, luggage and start time.
SZU016.stop_after: The visitor reaches the chosen anchor with buffer.

SZU017.guest_value: Make garden stairs, bridges, heat and walking surfaces visible.
SZU017.choose_rule: Use to shorten or remove garden/water-town branches.
SZU017.stop_after: The visitor has a credible route or a clear no-go.

SZU018.guest_value: Give a one-day Suzhou structure with one garden and one water-city/craft option.
SZU018.choose_rule: Use one anchor only when returning to Shanghai the same day.
SZU018.stop_after: The visitor has a realistic rail and return buffer.

SZU019.guest_value: Use two days for garden, water-city and craft/performance without repeating scenic loops.
SZU019.choose_rule: Add a new question per day; water towns need separate time.
SZU019.stop_after: Each day has a distinct theme and recovery.

SZU020.guest_value: Keep Suzhou workable through heat/rain and crowded garden conditions.
SZU020.choose_rule: Hold until current weather and opening rules are known.
SZU020.stop_after: The visitor recovers without losing the day’s question.
